CREATE VIEW report.order_summary WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
-- Projection column order is the published Arrow contract.
SELECT -- noqa: ST06
  base.code,
  base.total,
  customer."name" AS customer_name
FROM "order" AS base
  INNER JOIN customer AS customer ON base.customer_id = customer.id
COMMENT ON VIEW report.order_summary IS 'Orders with their customer''s name, for reporting.'
